What to expect on the call

  • 0–5 min

    Quick intro. Aaron will ask you to share a little about your business and what brought you here.

  • 5–20 min

    He'll ask about your operations, team size, current tools, and the specific pain points that made you start thinking about AI.

  • 20–30 min

    You'll hear an honest take on where AI fits for your situation, and where it doesn't. No upselling.
